Predicting Bus Arrival Status in Bengaluru

How It Works: From Data to Prediction
Enhancing urban commuting with real-time, predictive insights
Step-by-Step Process
1
📱 User Opens Android Application
Commuter launches the ML-powered Android app to access real-time bus predictions for their journey planning in Bengaluru.
Android
2
🌐 Fetch Real-time Bus Data
App connects to Bengaluru transit API to retrieve live GPS coordinates, speed data, and current bus location information.
API
3
⚡ Data Preprocessing & Cleaning
Raw transit data is cleaned, normalized, and structured on the device or backend server for optimal machine learning processing.
Python
4
⚙️ Feature Extraction
Key predictive features are extracted: current speed, travel time, distance covered, traffic conditions, and historical patterns.
ML Pipeline
5
🧠 Decision Tree Model Processing
Trained Decision Tree Classifier analyzes extracted features using historical data patterns to generate intelligent arrival predictions.
Scikit-learn
6
🎯 Bus Status Prediction
Model generates precise arrival status prediction: Early (ahead of schedule), On-Time (within expected window), or Late (delayed).
Classification
7
🗺️ Interactive Map Display
Prediction results are visualized on Google Maps with color-coded icons and status indicators for intuitive user experience.
Google Maps SDK

🚌 Predictive Results

Commuters receive accurate, actionable arrival predictions to optimize their travel planning and reduce unnecessary waiting times.
